theorems.name: duty_out_of_range_refused
theorems.doc: (S) A duty over 100 % is refused and changes nothing.
theorems.statement:
theorem duty_out_of_range_refused (st : Heater) (m : DutyMsg) (hu : m.utf8 = true) (hp : m.parsed = true)
    (hd : m.duty.val > 100) :
    duty_set st m = ok (st, Handled.Unexpected, NO_EFFECTS)
theorems.proof:
theorem duty_out_of_range_refused (st : Heater) (m : DutyMsg) (hu : m.utf8 = true) (hp : m.parsed = true)
    (hd : m.duty.val > 100) :
    duty_set st m = ok (st, Handled.Unexpected, NO_EFFECTS) := by
  unfold duty_set
  have : m.duty > 100#u8 := by scalar_tac
  simp [hu, hp, this]

theorems.name: sent_duty_le_100
theorems.doc: (S) Whatever is sent to the SSR is the message's duty, at most 100 %.
theorems.statement:
theorem sent_duty_le_100 (st : Heater) (m : DutyMsg) {st' h e d}
    (hr : duty_set st m = ok (st', h, e)) (hs : e.send = some d) : d = m.duty ∧ d.val ≤ 100
theorems.proof:
theorem sent_duty_le_100 (st : Heater) (m : DutyMsg) {st' h e d}
    (hr : duty_set st m = ok (st', h, e)) (hs : e.send = some d) : d = m.duty ∧ d.val ≤ 100 := by
  rcases st with ⟨ctl, sd⟩
  rcases m with ⟨u, p, d0, s, c, sr, sm, now⟩
  simp only [duty_set, expires_after] at hr
  cases u <;> cases p <;> cases s <;> cases c <;> cases ctl <;> (try simp [NO_EFFECTS] at hr) <;>
    (try split_ifs at hr) <;> (try simp [NO_EFFECTS] at hr) <;> (try obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := hr) <;>
    (try simp_all) <;> scalar_tac

theorems.name: remote_mismatch_refused
theorems.doc: (S) A remote that is not the one in control is refused: nothing changes, nothing is sent.
theorems.statement:
theorem remote_mismatch_refused (st : Heater) (m : DutyMsg) (exp : Std.U64)
    (hc : st.ctl = Ctl.Remote exp) (hu : m.utf8 = true) (hp : m.parsed = true) (hd : m.duty.val ≤ 100)
    (hs : m.sender = true) (hk : m.control = Control.Remote) (hn : m.same_remote = false) :
    duty_set st m = ok (st, Handled.Unexpected, NO_EFFECTS)
theorems.proof:
theorem remote_mismatch_refused (st : Heater) (m : DutyMsg) (exp : Std.U64)
    (hc : st.ctl = Ctl.Remote exp) (hu : m.utf8 = true) (hp : m.parsed = true) (hd : m.duty.val ≤ 100)
    (hs : m.sender = true) (hk : m.control = Control.Remote) (hn : m.same_remote = false) :
    duty_set st m = ok (st, Handled.Unexpected, NO_EFFECTS) := by
  have : ¬ m.duty > 100#u8 := by scalar_tac
  simp [duty_set, hc, hu, hp, hs, hk, hn, this]

theorems.name: expired_remote_refused
theorems.doc: (S) The remote in control that missed its check-in is refused (the expiry task then takes the duty to 0).
theorems.statement:
theorem expired_remote_refused (st : Heater) (m : DutyMsg) (exp : Std.U64)
    (hc : st.ctl = Ctl.Remote exp) (hu : m.utf8 = true) (hp : m.parsed = true) (hd : m.duty.val ≤ 100)
    (hs : m.sender = true) (hk : m.control = Control.Remote) (he : exp.val ≤ m.now.val) :
    duty_set st m = ok (st, Handled.Unexpected, NO_EFFECTS)
theorems.proof:
theorem expired_remote_refused (st : Heater) (m : DutyMsg) (exp : Std.U64)
    (hc : st.ctl = Ctl.Remote exp) (hu : m.utf8 = true) (hp : m.parsed = true) (hd : m.duty.val ≤ 100)
    (hs : m.sender = true) (hk : m.control = Control.Remote) (he : exp.val ≤ m.now.val) :
    duty_set st m = ok (st, Handled.Unexpected, NO_EFFECTS) := by
  have : ¬ m.duty > 100#u8 := by scalar_tac
  have he' : m.now ≥ exp := by scalar_tac
  cases hn : m.same_remote <;> simp [duty_set, hc, hu, hp, hs, hk, hn, this, he']

theorems.name: anonymous_refused
theorems.doc: (S) A command without a non-blank `device` property is refused.
theorems.statement:
theorem anonymous_refused (st : Heater) (m : DutyMsg) (hu : m.utf8 = true) (hp : m.parsed = true)
    (hd : m.duty.val ≤ 100) (hs : m.sender = false) :
    duty_set st m = ok (st, Handled.Invalid, NO_EFFECTS)
theorems.proof:
theorem anonymous_refused (st : Heater) (m : DutyMsg) (hu : m.utf8 = true) (hp : m.parsed = true)
    (hd : m.duty.val ≤ 100) (hs : m.sender = false) :
    duty_set st m = ok (st, Handled.Invalid, NO_EFFECTS) := by
  have : ¬ m.duty > 100#u8 := by scalar_tac
  simp [duty_set, hu, hp, hs, this]

theorems.name: remote_must_check_in
theorems.doc: (S) A remote in control after a command expires at most 60 s after it: a remote that stops checking in loses control.
theorems.statement:
theorem remote_must_check_in (st : Heater) (m : DutyMsg) {st' h e} (exp : Std.U64)
    (hr : duty_set st m = ok (st', h, e)) (hc : st'.ctl = Ctl.Remote exp) :
    st'.ctl = st.ctl ∨ exp.val ≤ m.now.val + 60000000
theorems.proof:
theorem remote_must_check_in (st : Heater) (m : DutyMsg) {st' h e} (exp : Std.U64)
    (hr : duty_set st m = ok (st', h, e)) (hc : st'.ctl = Ctl.Remote exp) :
    st'.ctl = st.ctl ∨ exp.val ≤ m.now.val + 60000000 := by
  rcases st with ⟨ctl, sd⟩
  rcases m with ⟨u, p, d0, s, c, sr, sm, now⟩
  simp only [duty_set, expires_after] at hr
  have hv := sat_le now REMOTE_CHECKIN_US
  have hk : REMOTE_CHECKIN_US.val = 60000000 := by unfold REMOTE_CHECKIN_US; rfl
  cases u <;> cases p <;> cases s <;> cases c <;> cases ctl <;> (try simp [NO_EFFECTS] at hr) <;>
    (try split_ifs at hr) <;> (try simp [NO_EFFECTS] at hr) <;> (try obtain ⟨rfl, _, rfl⟩ := hr) <;>
    (try simp_all) <;> (try (subst_vars; omega)) <;> (try (left; rfl))

theorems.name: refused_sends_nothing
theorems.doc: (S) Only a remote's check-in or a manual command sends a duty, and only the message's: an unparsed, anonymous or refused one sends nothing.
theorems.statement:
theorem refused_sends_nothing (st : Heater) (m : DutyMsg) {st' h e}
    (hr : duty_set st m = ok (st', h, e)) (hh : h ≠ Handled.Ok) : e.send = none ∧ st' = st
theorems.proof:
theorem refused_sends_nothing (st : Heater) (m : DutyMsg) {st' h e}
    (hr : duty_set st m = ok (st', h, e)) (hh : h ≠ Handled.Ok) : e.send = none ∧ st' = st := by
  rcases st with ⟨ctl, sd⟩
  rcases m with ⟨u, p, d0, s, c, sr, sm, now⟩
  simp only [duty_set, expires_after] at hr
  cases u <;> cases p <;> cases s <;> cases c <;> cases ctl <;> (try simp [NO_EFFECTS] at hr) <;>
    (try split_ifs at hr) <;> (try simp [NO_EFFECTS] at hr) <;> (try obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := hr) <;>
    simp_all [NO_EFFECTS]

theorems.name: expire_zeroes
theorems.doc: (S) A remote past its check-in loses control and the duty goes to 0.
theorems.statement:
theorem expire_zeroes (st : Heater) (now exp : Std.U64) (hc : st.ctl = Ctl.Remote exp) (he : exp.val ≤ now.val) :
    expire st now = ok ({ st with ctl := Ctl.Nobody }, some 0#u8)
theorems.proof:
theorem expire_zeroes (st : Heater) (now exp : Std.U64) (hc : st.ctl = Ctl.Remote exp) (he : exp.val ≤ now.val) :
    expire st now = ok ({ st with ctl := Ctl.Nobody }, some 0#u8) := by
  have : now ≥ exp := by scalar_tac
  simp [expire, hc, this]

theorems.name: expire_only_expired
theorems.doc: (S) The expiry touches nothing else: a live remote, manual control or no controller.
theorems.statement:
theorem expire_only_expired (st : Heater) (now : Std.U64) {st' o} (hr : expire st now = ok (st', o))
    (hl : ∀ exp, st.ctl = Ctl.Remote exp → now.val < exp.val) : st' = st ∧ o = none
theorems.proof:
theorem expire_only_expired (st : Heater) (now : Std.U64) {st' o} (hr : expire st now = ok (st', o))
    (hl : ∀ exp, st.ctl = Ctl.Remote exp → now.val < exp.val) : st' = st ∧ o = none := by
  rcases hc : st.ctl with _ | exp | _
  · simp [expire, hc] at hr; exact ⟨hr.1.symm, hr.2.symm⟩
  · have h1 := hl exp hc
    have : ¬ exp.val ≤ now.val := by omega
    simp [expire, hc, this] at hr; exact ⟨hr.1.symm, hr.2.symm⟩
  · simp [expire, hc] at hr; exact ⟨hr.1.symm, hr.2.symm⟩

theorems.name: reset_only_unretained
theorems.doc: (S) A retained `reset` does not reset the device (no reset loop at every connection).
theorems.statement: theorem reset_only_unretained (r : Bool) : reset_allowed r = ok (!r)
theorems.proof:
theorem reset_only_unretained (r : Bool) : reset_allowed r = ok (!r) := by
  simp [reset_allowed]

theorems.name: overtemp_locks
theorems.doc: (S) A valid reading at or over 70 °C locks the SSR.
theorems.statement:
theorem overtemp_locks (st : Safety) (t16 : Std.I32) (ts : Std.U64) (ht : t16.val ≥ 1120) {st' o}
    (hr : on_reading st true t16 ts = ok (st', o)) : st'.locked = true
theorems.proof:
theorem overtemp_locks (st : Safety) (t16 : Std.I32) (ts : Std.U64) (ht : t16.val ≥ 1120) {st' o}
    (hr : on_reading st true t16 ts = ok (st', o)) : st'.locked = true := by
  have hl : t16 ≥ LOCK_T16 := by simp [LOCK_T16]; scalar_tac
  have hu : ¬ t16 < UNLOCK_T16 := by simp [UNLOCK_T16]; scalar_tac
  unfold on_reading sat_add at hr
  cases hk : st.locked <;> simp [hk, hl, hu] at hr <;> rw [← hr.1]

theorems.name: locked_until_cool
theorems.doc: (S) A locked SSR stays locked until a valid reading under 30 °C.
theorems.statement:
theorem locked_until_cool (st : Safety) (v : Bool) (t16 : Std.I32) (ts : Std.U64) (hk : st.locked = true)
    (hc : v = false ∨ t16.val ≥ 480) {st' o} (hr : on_reading st v t16 ts = ok (st', o)) : st'.locked = true
theorems.proof:
theorem locked_until_cool (st : Safety) (v : Bool) (t16 : Std.I32) (ts : Std.U64) (hk : st.locked = true)
    (hc : v = false ∨ t16.val ≥ 480) {st' o} (hr : on_reading st v t16 ts = ok (st', o)) : st'.locked = true := by
  unfold on_reading sat_add at hr
  rcases hc with rfl | hc
  · simp at hr; rw [← hr.1, hk]
  · have hu : ¬ t16 < UNLOCK_T16 := by simp [UNLOCK_T16]; scalar_tac
    cases v <;> simp [hk, hu] at hr <;> rw [← hr.1] <;> simp [hk]

theorems.name: invalid_reading_ignored
theorems.doc: (S) A reading without a temperature (a sensor error) changes nothing: in particular it does not move the deadline.
theorems.statement:
theorem invalid_reading_ignored (st : Safety) (t16 : Std.I32) (ts : Std.U64) :
    on_reading st false t16 ts = ok (st, SafetyOut.Nothing)
theorems.proof:
theorem invalid_reading_ignored (st : Safety) (t16 : Std.I32) (ts : Std.U64) :
    on_reading st false t16 ts = ok (st, SafetyOut.Nothing) := by
  simp [on_reading]

theorems.name: missing_locks
theorems.doc: (S) No valid reading by the deadline locks the SSR.
theorems.statement:
theorem missing_locks (st : Safety) (now : Std.U64) {st' o} (hr : on_missing st now = ok (st', o)) :
    st'.locked = true
theorems.proof:
theorem missing_locks (st : Safety) (now : Std.U64) {st' o} (hr : on_missing st now = ok (st', o)) :
    st'.locked = true := by
  unfold on_missing sat_add at hr
  cases hk : st.locked <;> simp [hk] at hr <;> rw [← hr.1]

theorems.name: ssr_lock_zeroes
theorems.doc: (S) A lock zeroes the pattern.
theorems.statement:
theorem ssr_lock_zeroes (st : Ssr) (d : Option Std.U8) :
    ssr_step st (some SsrCmd.Lock) d = ok { locked := true, pattern := 0#u8 }
theorems.proof:
theorem ssr_lock_zeroes (st : Ssr) (d : Option Std.U8) :
    ssr_step st (some SsrCmd.Lock) d = ok { locked := true, pattern := 0#u8 } := by
  simp [ssr_step]

theorems.name: ssr_locked_ignores_duty
theorems.doc: (S) While locked (and not unlocked), a duty is ignored.
theorems.statement:
theorem ssr_locked_ignores_duty (st : Ssr) (d : Option Std.U8) (hk : st.locked = true) :
    ssr_step st none d = ok st
theorems.proof:
theorem ssr_locked_ignores_duty (st : Ssr) (d : Option Std.U8) (hk : st.locked = true) :
    ssr_step st none d = ok st := by
  simp [ssr_step, hk]

theorems.name: ssr_pattern_le_100
theorems.doc: (S) The pattern's duty is never over 100 %.
theorems.statement:
theorem ssr_pattern_le_100 (st : Ssr) (c : Option SsrCmd) (d : Option Std.U8) (hs : st.pattern.val ≤ 100) {st'}
    (hr : ssr_step st c d = ok st') : st'.pattern.val ≤ 100
theorems.proof:
theorem ssr_pattern_le_100 (st : Ssr) (c : Option SsrCmd) (d : Option Std.U8) (hs : st.pattern.val ≤ 100) {st'}
    (hr : ssr_step st c d = ok st') : st'.pattern.val ≤ 100 := by
  unfold ssr_step at hr
  rcases c with _ | ⟨_ | _⟩ <;> rcases d with _ | d <;> simp at hr <;> (try split_ifs at hr) <;>
    (try simp at hr) <;> subst_vars <;> simp_all <;> (try scalar_tac)

theorems.name: pattern_zero_off
theorems.doc: (S) 0 % never conducts.
theorems.statement: theorem pattern_zero_off (i : Std.U32) (hi : i.val < 100) : pattern_on 0#u8 i = ok false
theorems.proof:
theorem pattern_zero_off (i : Std.U32) (hi : i.val < 100) : pattern_on 0#u8 i = ok false := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hp⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (pattern_on_spec 0#u8 i (by simp) hi)
  rw [hb]; simp at hp; cases b <;> simp_all

theorems.name: pattern_full_on
theorems.doc: (S) 100 % conducts at every step.
theorems.statement: theorem pattern_full_on (i : Std.U32) (hi : i.val < 100) : pattern_on 100#u8 i = ok true
theorems.proof:
theorem pattern_full_on (i : Std.U32) (hi : i.val < 100) : pattern_on 100#u8 i = ok true := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hp⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (pattern_on_spec 100#u8 i (by simp) hi)
  rw [hb]; simp at hp; cases b <;> simp_all; omega

theorems.name: pattern_out_of_range_off
theorems.doc: (C) Outside 0..100 % or past the last step, nothing conducts (upstream panics on a duty over 100; no caller passes one).
theorems.statement:
theorem pattern_out_of_range_off (d : Std.U8) (i : Std.U32) (h : d.val > 100 ∨ i.val ≥ 100) :
    pattern_on d i = ok false
theorems.proof:
theorem pattern_out_of_range_off (d : Std.U8) (i : Std.U32) (h : d.val > 100 ∨ i.val ≥ 100) :
    pattern_on d i = ok false := by
  unfold pattern_on
  have hS : STEPS.val = 100 := by unfold STEPS; rfl
  rcases h with h | h
  · have : d > 100#u8 := by scalar_tac
    simp [this]
  · have : i ≥ STEPS := by scalar_tac
    split_ifs <;> simp

expire.lean:
def expire
  (st : Heater) (now : Std.U64) : Result (Heater × (Option Std.U8)) := do
  match st.ctl with
  | Ctl.Nobody => ok (st, none)
  | Ctl.Remote expires =>
    if now >= expires
    then ok ({ st with ctl := Ctl.Nobody }, some 0#u8)
    else ok (st, none)
  | Ctl.Manual => ok (st, none)

ssr_step.lean:
def ssr_step
  (st : Ssr) (cmd : Option SsrCmd) (new_duty : Option Std.U8) :
  Result Ssr
  := do
  let s1 ←
    match cmd with
    | none => ok st
    | some sc =>
      do
      let (b, i) ←
        match sc with
        | SsrCmd.Lock => ok (true, 0#u8)
        | SsrCmd.Unlock => ok (false, st.pattern)
      ok ({ locked := b, pattern := i } : Ssr)
  if s1.locked
  then ok s1
  else
    match new_duty with
    | none => ok s1
    | some d =>
      if d <= 100#u8
      then ok { locked := false, pattern := d }
      else ok s1

SafetyOut.lean:
@[discriminant isize]
inductive SafetyOut where
| Nothing : SafetyOut
| LockOvertemp : SafetyOut
| LockMissing : SafetyOut
| Unlock : SafetyOut

Ctl.lean:
@[discriminant isize]
inductive Ctl where
| Nobody : Ctl
| Remote : Std.U64 → Ctl
| Manual : Ctl

Heater.lean:
structure Heater where
  ctl : Ctl
  duty : Std.U8

duty_set.lean:
def duty_set
  (st : Heater) (m : DutyMsg) : Result (Heater × Handled × Effects) := do
  if m.utf8
  then
    if m.parsed
    then
      if m.duty > 100#u8
      then ok (st, Handled.Unexpected, NO_EFFECTS)
      else
        if m.sender
        then
          match m.control with
          | Control.Manual =>
            match st.ctl with
            | Ctl.Nobody =>
              ok ({ ctl := Ctl.Manual, duty := m.duty }, Handled.Ok,
                {
                  send := (some m.duty),
                  announce := true,
                  record_sender := true
                })
            | Ctl.Remote _ =>
              ok ({ ctl := Ctl.Manual, duty := m.duty }, Handled.Ok,
                {
                  send := (some m.duty),
                  announce := true,
                  record_sender := true
                })
            | Ctl.Manual =>
              ok ({ ctl := Ctl.Manual, duty := m.duty }, Handled.Ok,
                {
                  send := (some m.duty),
                  announce := (¬ m.same_manual),
                  record_sender := (¬ m.same_manual)
                })
          | Control.Remote =>
            match st.ctl with
            | Ctl.Nobody =>
              let i ← expires_after m.now
              ok ({ ctl := (Ctl.Remote i), duty := m.duty }, Handled.Ok,
                {
                  send := (some m.duty),
                  announce := true,
                  record_sender := true
                })
            | Ctl.Remote expires =>
              if m.same_remote
              then
                if m.now >= expires
                then ok (st, Handled.Unexpected, NO_EFFECTS)
                else
                  let i ← expires_after m.now
                  ok ({ ctl := (Ctl.Remote i), duty := m.duty }, Handled.Ok,
                    {
                      send := (some m.duty),
                      announce := false,
                      record_sender := false
                    })
              else ok (st, Handled.Unexpected, NO_EFFECTS)
            | Ctl.Manual =>
              let i ← expires_after m.now
              ok ({ ctl := (Ctl.Remote i), duty := m.duty }, Handled.Ok,
                {
                  send := (some m.duty),
                  announce := true,
                  record_sender := true
                })
          | Control.Other => ok (st, Handled.Unexpected, NO_EFFECTS)
          | Control.Missing => ok (st, Handled.Invalid, NO_EFFECTS)
        else ok (st, Handled.Invalid, NO_EFFECTS)
    else ok (st, Handled.Invalid, NO_EFFECTS)
  else ok (st, Handled.Utf8, NO_EFFECTS)

expires_after.lean:
def expires_after (now : Std.U64) : Result Std.U64 := do
  ok (core.num.U64.saturating_add now REMOTE_CHECKIN_US)

Ssr.lean:
structure Ssr where
  locked : Bool
  pattern : Std.U8

on_reading.lean:
def on_reading
  (st : Safety) (valid : Bool) (t16 : Std.I32) (ts : Std.U64) :
  Result (Safety × SafetyOut)
  := do
  if valid
  then
    let deadline ← sat_add ts MISSING_WINDOW_US
    if st.locked
    then
      if t16 < UNLOCK_T16
      then ok ({ locked := false, deadline }, SafetyOut.Unlock)
      else ok ({ locked := true, deadline }, SafetyOut.Nothing)
    else
      if t16 >= LOCK_T16
      then ok ({ locked := true, deadline }, SafetyOut.LockOvertemp)
      else ok ({ locked := false, deadline }, SafetyOut.Nothing)
  else ok (st, SafetyOut.Nothing)

pattern_on.lean:
def pattern_on (duty : Std.U8) (i : Std.U32) : Result Bool := do
  if duty > 100#u8
  then ok false
  else
    if i >= STEPS
    then ok false
    else
      let d ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 duty)
      let i1 ← i + 1#u32
      let i2 ← d * i1
      let i3 ← 50#u32 + i2
      let i4 ← i3 / 100#u32
      let i5 ← d * i
      let i6 ← 50#u32 + i5
      let i7 ← i6 / 100#u32
      ok (i4 > i7)

sat_add.lean:
def sat_add (a : Std.U64) (b : Std.U64) : Result Std.U64 := do
  ok (core.num.U64.saturating_add a b)

Safety.lean:
structure Safety where
  locked : Bool
  deadline : Std.U64

Handled.lean:
@[discriminant isize]
inductive Handled where
| Ok : Handled
| Utf8 : Handled
| Invalid : Handled
| Unexpected : Handled

SsrCmd.lean:
@[discriminant isize]
inductive SsrCmd where
| Lock : SsrCmd
| Unlock : SsrCmd

DutyMsg.lean:
structure DutyMsg where
  utf8 : Bool
  parsed : Bool
  duty : Std.U8
  sender : Bool
  control : Control
  same_remote : Bool
  same_manual : Bool
  now : Std.U64

Control.lean:
@[discriminant isize]
inductive Control where
| Manual : Control
| Remote : Control
| Other : Control
| Missing : Control

reset_allowed.lean:
def reset_allowed (retained : Bool) : Result Bool := do
  ok (¬ retained)

on_missing.lean:
def on_missing
  (st : Safety) (now : Std.U64) : Result (Safety × SafetyOut) := do
  let deadline ← sat_add now MISSING_WINDOW_US
  if st.locked
  then ok ({ locked := true, deadline }, SafetyOut.Nothing)
  else ok ({ locked := true, deadline }, SafetyOut.LockMissing)

Effects.lean:
structure Effects where
  send : Option Std.U8
  announce : Bool
  record_sender : Bool

NO_EFFECTS.kernel_code: const NO_EFFECTS: Effects = Effects { send: None, announce: false, record_sender: false };
